title: Abba
gist: An Aramaic word for father used by children at home, kept untranslated in Greek texts. Jesus prays 'Abba' in Gethsemane, and Paul says the Spirit makes us cry 'Abba, Father'. It shows how intimately Jesus spoke to God, and invites us to the same.

passages.note: 'You have received the spirit of adoption of sons, whereby we cry: Abba (Father).'
The Spirit of his Son crying 'Abba'.
